items.title: Harry Edison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: We had a dancer in there, a singer, Marie Bryant, she was in the movie. And Archie Savage, who was a dancer.

ctx.x: How long did it take to make it? Was there a lot of starting and stopping and reshooting of different things?

No, it went down absolutely with no hitch at all. We had a dancer in there, a singer, Marie Bryant, she was in the movie. And Archie Savage, who was a dancer. It was no problem, in fact everybody out there in the studio was surprised that we got through so early. It was fantastic.
I don’t think any jazz film since has gotten the acclaim.
